children: Nauticus Robotics received a holder notice extending the maturity date of $3,985,000 of outstanding debentures by one year to September 9, 2027.
Holder exercised contractual right to extend maturity of Original Issue Discount Senior Secured Convertible Debentures from 9/9/2026 to 9/9/2027.
Extensions cover entire $3,985,000 principal plus accrued and future interest, liquidated damages and other amounts under the Debentures.
No amendment, consent fee or additional consideration payable; terms, guarantees, liens and security interests remain in effect.
Debentures continue to accrue interest and remain convertible and enforceable through the extended maturity unless earlier satisfied.
